title: The Broken Thorn
author: Xanthe Sterling
blurb: Ulyana Quintana, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
